**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement contains no minimum purchase or volume commitment:

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall." This satisfies both preferred elements directly.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — bars any "platform, support, administration, minimum-use, or similar charge" not identified in the Order Form, closing the back door to a disguised minimum.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** — Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no "minimum-volume" commitment.

I also checked for hidden take-or-pay or usage-cap mechanics: the only other "shortfall" references (§ 22.2 / § 22.3) are a usage-audit underpayment true-up on actual consumption, not a commitment or penalty, and nothing imposes a volume ceiling on Customer usage. No redline proposed.
